version: 0.1.0
kind: workspace-folder
metadata:
  name: system.history
  description: Local historical snapshots and activity traces that remain outside the tracked baseline.
spec:
  path: .workspace/system.history
  lifecycle: volatile
  tracking: ignored
  volatility: medium
  naming:
    reserved_files:
      - _root.yaml
      - "*.history.yaml"
    versioning: semver
